name: Shawnee County, KS
findings: Shawnee County has 876 nonprofit organizations. 437 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 382 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Shawnee County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
51% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
